system.text:
This character is addicted to a substance. If presented with the substance, the character will automatically consume it unless he or she passes a Steel test. If denied the substance for more than a few hours, the character suffers a +1 Ob penalty until reacquainted with the source of his or her addiction. If denied for a longer period of time, take a -1D blanket penalty to all stats and skills.

Type: Dt. Cost: 3 pts.

Source: Burning Wheel Codex, p. 516
